# Integrity { #timetoalign.timelines.Integrity }

```python
timelines.Integrity(algorithm, digest, *, _unknown_keys=dict())
```

The digest of a resource's raw bytes and the hash function computing it.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type         | Description                                                                                                                               |
|-----------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| algorithm | [str](`str`) | The hash function as the PREMIS vocabulary of cryptographic hash functions names it, one of :data:`INTEGRITY_ALGORITHMS` (``"SHA-256"``). |
| digest    | [str](`str`) | The digest in lower-case hexadecimal.                                                                                                     |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                 |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the algorithm is none of :data:`INTEGRITY_ALGORITHMS` or the digest is no lower-case hexadecimal string. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> Integrity("SHA-256", "5f9a").to_dict()
{'algorithm': 'SHA-256', 'digest': '5f9a'}
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [from_dict](#timetoalign.timelines.Integrity.from_dict) | Read an ``integrity`` object, keeping its unknown keys. |
| [of_bytes](#timetoalign.timelines.Integrity.of_bytes) | The SHA-256 digest of *data*. |
| [to_dict](#timetoalign.timelines.Integrity.to_dict) | Write the ``integrity`` object. |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.Integrity.from_dict }

```python
timelines.Integrity.from_dict(data, what="a resource's integrity")
```

Read an ``integrity`` object, keeping its unknown keys.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                          |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *data* is no object holding ``algorithm`` and ``digest``, or either is malformed. |

### of_bytes { #timetoalign.timelines.Integrity.of_bytes }

```python
timelines.Integrity.of_bytes(data)
```

The SHA-256 digest of *data*.

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> Integrity.of_bytes(b"").digest[:12]
'e3b0c44298fc'
```

### to_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.Integrity.to_dict }

```python
timelines.Integrity.to_dict()
```

Write the ``integrity`` object.
